method: GET only the exact approved catalog JSON through owned aliases. Withdrawn routes use explicit HEAD at every redirect, including303. Redirects are followed only to known owned hosts and the same mapped path, with a maximum of five redirects. TLS verification uses system defaults. Ordinary cached URLs are used without cache busting. No response bodies, media, screenshots or recordings are saved.
transport: Ordinary curl defaults, standard TLS validation, no cache busting. HEAD requests omit --fail because the local wrapper returns a nonstandard error exit for expected404; the HTTP status remains explicitly checked.
